title: Where do you live? Countries with -ban

sections.title: Country names
sections.content: Countries end in *-ország* (country) or *-ia*: *Anglia* (England), *Németország* (Germany), *Spanyolország* (Spain), *Franciaország* (France). To say you live in a country, add *-ban*, as you know it from towns and rooms: *Angliában lakom.* After *Anglia* the final *a* becomes *á*: *Angliá-ban*. After *-ország* just add *-ban*: *Németországban*.

sections.title: Asking and answering
sections.content: Ask *Hol laksz?* (Where do you live?) and answer with the country in *-ban*. Join the two facts with *és*: *Angol vagyok, és Angliában lakom.*

items.english: I am English and I live in England.

sections.content: *Magyarország* (Hungary) takes a different ending, which comes later; here use only the countries in the table. Do not use *-ba* for living somewhere: *-ba* means "into", so *Angliába lakom* is wrong.
